plan.title: Smart basket
plan.subtitle: Tell us what you need — we’ll suggest the cheapest stores, with optional brand choices.
plan.stepNeeds: What do you want to buy?
plan.needsHint: Add milk, oil, rice, toothpaste… Then lock a brand when you care (e.g. Afia for oil).
plan.emptyNeeds: Add at least one item to plan a basket.
plan.brandHint: Leave as any brand for the cheapest option

compare.title: Compare
compare.subtitle: Pick stores, then a category or a specific product.
compare.stepWhat: What do you want to compare?
compare.maxStoresHint: Limit how many stores to compare (1, 2, or 3), then tap the stores in order.
compare.productHint: Search by product or brand name
compare.needStores: Select at least one supermarket first.
compare.needCategory: Choose a category such as Cooking Oil.
compare.needProduct: Search and select a product to compare.
compare.noCategoryProducts: No priced products in this category for the selected stores.
compare.categoryResultsHint: Sorted by best price among your selected stores.

home.headline: Save more on your groceries
home.subtitle: Add your products and we’ll compare prices across stores.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search for a product or brand

search.title: Search
search.hint: Search in English or Arabic — one product, prices from every store

product.selectStoreHint: Select at least one supermarket to compare.

offers.title: Offers
offers.weeklyThisWeek: Tap a supermarket, then tap a product image to add it to your basket
offers.clickablePromos: This week’s promotions — tap image to add
offers.clickablePromosHint: Each card shows the item photo, description, and price. Tap to add to your basket.
offers.tapLeafletHint: Tap any product on the flyer to add it to your list
offers.noLeaflets: No leaflets are published for this week yet.
offers.noPages: Leaflet pages are not available yet.
offers.comingSoon: Filters and sorting arrive in a later phase.

list.missingInOptimize: {{count}} item(s) have no price in selected stores.

profile.title: Profile
profile.anonymous: Browsing as guest — search and compare freely.
profile.storesHint: Choose which supermarkets appear in search and basket comparisons.

admin.leafletsSubtitle: Pull weekly promotions, match products, and publish to Offers.
admin.pipelineHint: Demo mode runs Mock OCR locally and publishes into this browser. With Docker + Hasura, the leaflet-processing service can write to the database.
admin.ingestDone: OCR finished — review matches then publish
admin.publishDone: Published — open Offers to see updated promotions
admin.hotspotsHint: Drag a rectangle on the leaflet, pick the canonical product and price, then save. Coordinates are stored as percentages.
admin.noLeafletImage: No leaflet image for this store/page. Run sync:leaflets first.
